name: FilePreview
usage: Previewing attachments and uploaded files, viewing images in a gallery, checking logs and data files

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the preview is open.

props.name: items
props.description: Files to switch between.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the file shown (controlled).

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when switching to another file; without it, the files cannot be switched.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when closing (`Esc`, the close button, clicking outside the file, dragging it away).

props.name: stage
props.description:
Fixed viewer background; when omitted, the viewer background from ThemeProvider is used and can be changed in
the toolbar.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog; "File preview" when omitted.

props.name: testId
props.description: Test id, rendered as `data-testid` on the dialog.

props.name: actions
props.description: Your own buttons in the toolbar for the file shown, such as "Share" or "Show in folder"; use IconButton.

props.name: onDownload
props.description:
Shows a "Download" button and is called when it is pressed; the application decides how to save the file
(a link with `download` in the browser, a save dialog in a desktop client). No button when omitted.

props.name: render
props.description:
Shows a file in your own way, such as PDF with a PDF library: return the content, or `undefined` to use the
built-in preview. The content fills the preview area; gestures (swiping, dragging to close) do not start on it.

props.name: renderMarkdown
props.description:
Renders the text of a Markdown file (`.md`, `text/markdown`), such as
`(text) => <Markdown content={text} />` with Markdown from `vellum-ui/ai`. Without it, Markdown files are shown
as their source text, wrapped, like other text files.

members.name: FilePreview.Inline
members.summary:
The preview as an area of the page, such as the right pane of a file list: a header with the file name, size
and buttons, and the file below it, filling the height of the parent. Images can be zoomed with a pinch,
`Ctrl` + wheel or a double click, and dragged when zoomed; "Full screen" opens the full-window preview.

props.name: item
props.description: The file shown; `null` shows "No file selected".

props.name: expandable
props.description: Shows a "Full screen" button that opens the file in the full-window preview (images fly out of the area and back).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the area; the file name when omitted.

props.name: testId
props.description: Test id, rendered as `data-testid`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Your own buttons in the toolbar for the file shown, such as "Share" or "Show in folder"; use IconButton.

props.name: onDownload
props.description:
Shows a "Download" button and is called when it is pressed; the application decides how to save the file
(a link with `download` in the browser, a save dialog in a desktop client). No button when omitted.

props.name: render
props.description:
Shows a file in your own way, such as PDF with a PDF library: return the content, or `undefined` to use the
built-in preview. The content fills the preview area; gestures (swiping, dragging to close) do not start on it.

props.name: renderMarkdown
props.description:
Renders the text of a Markdown file (`.md`, `text/markdown`), such as
`(text) => <Markdown content={text} />` with Markdown from `vellum-ui/ai`. Without it, Markdown files are shown
as their source text, wrapped, like other text files.

types.name: FilePreviewItem
types.summary:
A file shown by FilePreview. Give `src` (an address) or `file` (a `File` or `Blob` in memory); text that is already
in memory can be given as `content`.

fields.name: id
fields.description:
Unique ID. Thumbnails with the same ID in `data-vl-preview-id` (the tiles of ImageGrid have it) are where images
fly in from and back to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: File name, shown in the toolbar; its extension also decides how the file is shown when `type` is omitted.

fields.name: file
fields.description:
The file in memory (such as a file the user picked); an object URL is created for it while it is shown and
released afterwards.

fields.name: type
fields.description: MIME type, such as `image/png`; taken from `file`, or guessed from the extension of `name`, when omitted.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size in bytes, shown in the toolbar; taken from `file` when omitted.

fields.name: content
fields.description:
The text of a text file, when it is already in memory (such as a response body); used instead of loading
`src`.

fields.name: alt
fields.description: Alternative text of an image, read by screen readers; the file name when omitted.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Open any file of a list: images open from their tile and can be zoomed (wheel, double click, `+` / `-`), text and
data files are shown on a sheet, and the PDF, which the browser cannot show here, gets a card. Switch with `←` /
`→` or by dragging sideways; drag up or down to close.

examples.name: Inline
examples.title: Inline preview
examples.description:
`FilePreview.Inline` shows the selected file next to the list and fills the height of its parent. Zoom images with
a double click or `Ctrl` + wheel; "Full screen" opens the full-window preview, and the image flies out of the
area and back.

examples.name: Custom
examples.title: Downloads, actions and your own renderer
examples.description:
`onDownload` adds a "Download" button (here with a link that has `download`); `actions` adds your own buttons; and
`render` shows file types that the preview does not support, here a PDF as a summary card. Return `undefined` from
`render` to keep the built-in preview. `renderMarkdown` renders Markdown files, here with Markdown from
`vellum-ui/ai`; without it they are shown as text.
